note: editor (a publishing-role person) and bank (a financial institution) are unrelated entity classes sharing only an accept/reject decision template.
descent (downward movement) and calibration (instrument adjustment) are unrelated activities sharing only a hard/easy difficulty template.
panel denotes a group of people while editor denotes an individual, so the classes differ in cardinality despite both being gatekeeper roles.
greenhouse (a physical structure, typically a patient) and flood (a disaster event, typically an agent) are different ontological categories that only co-occur in destruction scenarios.
manuscript (literary submission) and loan_application (financial request document) are domain-specific document types, not interchangeable despite both being accepted/rejected.
follow is polysemous - the succession sense partly overlaps with replace but the pursuit sense ("following Layla") does not, so the classes are not co-extensive.
skylight (light-admitting roof window) and hatch (access opening) are co-hyponyms of "roof opening" with different functions, not synonyms.
hatch is a concrete object class while big is a scalar size property - a category mismatch, not synonymy.
replace is a dyadic substitution between two distinct entities while become is a monadic change of state/identity - different event structures.
purchase and sell are converse relations describing the same transaction from buyer vs seller perspective, so swapping would invert the agent role.
speak (verbal communication) and produce (creation/manufacture) share no semantic content beyond a common transitive-verb template.
be (stative copula/existence) and start (inchoative event of beginning) are fundamentally different predicate types.
committee is a group-of-people class while large is a scalar size property - a category mismatch.
